review.rationale: The Decision correctly binds the prior preflight failure through the preflight failure result and report while preserving the UNKNOWN_NOT_PERSISTED state. The host binding is exact (identities_only, credential_reference_only, no private key or credential persistence). Execution is strictly limited to one later separate SSH session, one lstat, one readlink, and one bounded target shape evaluation (test -d and test ! -L). The classification contract is complete, ordered, and covers all expected states without promoting classification to root cause, deployment success, or redeployment authority. Noncanonical raw targets are explicitly forbidden from persistence. Result fields and caps are sufficient and tightly scoped. Decision preparation performs no SSH. No repair, rollback, redeployment, release, commercial, or authority effect is created or authorized.
